provenance.paper_title: MovieChat+: Question-aware Sparse Memory for Long Video Question Answering

evidence.paraphrase: Question-aware sparse memory compresses long video tokens while preserving query-relevant content.

Redundant visual tokens are merged under the fixed Atkinson-Shiffrin-inspired policy. For MovieChat+, this specifically supports merging or deduplication of overlapping entries of question-aware sparse visual token memory.
Long streams are consolidated into sparse memory. For MovieChat+, this specifically supports episodic or hierarchical summarization of question-aware sparse visual token memory.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (question-aware sparse visual token memory) changes through merging or deduplication of overlapping entries, episodic or hierarchical summarization; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
